fade_in_hero.css: @keyframes fadeInHero { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .hero-content { animation: fadeInHero 1.2s ease-out forwards; }

hover_card_lift.css: .product-card { transition: transform 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease; } .product-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(200,130,154,0.18); } .product-card .quick-add { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; } .product-card:hover .quick-add { opacity: 1; }

scroll_reveal_cards.css: @keyframes scrollReveal { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .reveal { opacity: 0; } .reveal.visible { animation: scrollReveal 0.8s ease-out forwards; }

home.layout: Full-bleed hero with model imagery and script tagline, followed by new arrivals grid, routine guide banner, bestsellers carousel, brand philosophy split section, and Instagram mosaic footer.

skincare.layout: Sidebar with skin-type filters on left and 3-column product grid on right, each card showing ingredient tags, mint 'NEW' badges, and gold premium markers.

routine.layout: AM/PM toggle header, vertical numbered 10-step routine builder with product recommendation cards and add-all CTA sticky at bottom.

about.layout: Editorial long-form layout with alternating image-text blocks: founder portrait, lab photos, certification badges row, bilingual philosophy text, and press logos strip.

reviews.layout: Filter bar at top, masonry-style photo review grid with star ratings, featured before/after comparison sliders, and blog journey cards below.
